Looking at the alignment handling:
- For `<` (left-aligned): `s = '%s%s*' % (s, fill)` - This appends fill characters after the value
- For `>` (right-aligned): `s = '%s*%s' % (fill, s)` - This prepends fill characters before the value
- For `^` (center-aligned): `s = '%s*%s%s*' % (fill, s, fill)` - This adds fill characters both before and after

The requirement says "Left- and center-aligned search operations must consume input up to the next space character." This means when searching, the pattern should stop at the next space. The current implementation just uses `*` which matches zero or more fill characters. But for a search operation, we need it to actually stop at the next space.
